ravi_prod: hey @maya, after yesterday's key rotation our prod app started getting 401s on /v1/chat. no code changes on our side.

maya_support: sorry to hear that — do you see an `invalid_api_key` error in the response body?

ravi_prod: yes, response body: {"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid API key"}}. staging and local are fine, only prod impacted.

maya_support: did you rotate from the dashboard or via API? and are you using hosted or dedicated keys?

ravi_prod: rotated via dashboard, single hosted key for the org. we uploaded new key into k8s secret and pointed Deployment to it.

eli_sre: quick theory: some infra components (sidecar/config agent) sometimes cache the value and don't pick up secret updates immediately. any config-agent or reloader in front of the app?

ravi_prod: yes — we use a config-agent sidecar that hot-reloads every 30m. we thought the redeploy would force refresh but maybe not.

maya_support: can you paste the `Authorization` header from a failing request (redact token)? e.g. `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>` — app logs or stdout is fine.

ravi_prod: log snippet from pod-123: "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_oldprefix_ABCDEF..." — looks like old key still being sent.

eli_sre: that confirms it. config-agent kept old secret in memory. quick repro steps: 1) rotate key via dashboard 2) update k8s Secret 3) rolling-restart app pods but leave sidecar running 4) sidecar still serves old value until its next refresh window.

maya_support: workaround: restart the config-agent/sidecar or trigger its reload. then verify with `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat` (should return 200).

ravi_prod: restarting sidecar now...

deploy-bot: deploy support/clear-config-cache started by eli_sre — job id d9f3a

ravi_prod: restarted sidecar, sending a test request — 200 OK, responses are normal again. thanks!

maya_support: great — marking as resolved and adding internal KB: "Post-rotation: restart config-agent to avoid stale API keys" :thumbsup:

eli_sre: follow-up action item: we'll add a post-rotation webhook to invalidate caches and a note in rotation docs. cc @product for visibility.

ravi_prod: appreciated, saved a lot of time. :raised_hands:

maya_support: closing this thread. reopen if it recurs.
